content.value: A sample of 40 officials of the Department of Environment was selected to test a (10) questionnaire. One question about environmental issues required a Yes or No answer. Based on this information answer the following questions: earm
(iii) What concept of probability does this illustrate?
(iv) Are each of the possible outcomes equally likely and mutually exclusive?
(v) 30 of the officials responded No. Based on these sample responses, what is the probability that an official will respond Yes?
